briefHtml:
NAV and the tape

  • NAV S$10,233,521 · reported +0.45% · real day move ≈ -0.04% (S$-4,440 vs yesterday's restated 10,237,961). NAV level authoritative.
  • Biggest mover: NVDA -5.47% to US$168.89 - day two of the Jensen Huang board-probe fallout (two-day ≈ -9.5%). In the book, silver -2.8% to $51.92 hit the SLVP/SILJ sleeve and the IBKR line.
  • The one thing: October CPI hot - headline +0.4% m/m (vs +0.3% exp), core +0.3% (vs +0.2%) - and core exactly met Waller's pre-committed test for considering a 50bp December hike. 8-9 Dec hike locked; jumbo ~9.5% odds. 10y closed 4.983% after topping 5% intraday - the 5.20% duration gate is ~22bp away.
  • US Tue: SPX 7,520.93 -0.38%, Dow 52,231.89 -0.30%, Nasdaq 25,065.87 -0.74%. VIX 19.46, -2.31% - rotation, not panic.
  • Asia Tue: STI +1.53% to 5,258.59 (post-Deepavali catch-up); HSI +0.44% to 24,557. SMIC +2.6% to HK$47.24 - broke above the HK$44-46 zone a day before Q3 (Thu). Xiaomi +1.66%, Tencent -0.14%.
  • Oil: Brent -2.58% below $90 (first since 31 Aug) on Iran de-escalation plus a ~1.4mb/d surplus (JPMorgan). Metals: gold $4,053.30 -2.11%, silver $51.92 -2.80%, ratio 78.06.
  • AI watch: Culper says Megaspeed "isn't the only company" helping China access chips; Anthropic opened its roadshow for a possible week-of-16-Nov Nasdaq debut (valuation above $1tn).

Flag integrity

  • riskFlags: ZERO - fourth consecutive clean snapshot.
  • L46.SI (Lum Chang): Yahoo 404, 30th consecutive session.
  • listedChgPct +2.66% mixes a two-session SGX move with one-day HK/US moves - directional, not live.
  • Nov 10 NAV restated UP to 10,237,961 (from 10,234,479); reported +0.45% vs real ≈ -0.04%.

Insider trades (last 7 days)

  • SGX direct check failed today - links.sgx.com announcements API unreachable; sweep via web sources only.
  • Wing Tai (W05.SI): no new Form 1s since 4 Nov as of the last good fetch - cadence pause now three trading sessions (5, 6, 10 Nov).
  • DBS, OCBC, UOB, Fraser and Neave, VICOM, Straits Trading, CDL, UOL, Yanlord, Ho Bee, Seatrium, YZJ, Singtel, Keppel REIT: none found. HK names (Tencent, SMIC, Xiaomi): none found. US ETFs: none by construction.

Congress filings (new, via Unusual Whales)

  • House Democrat (NY-3): Buy US T-Bill $15k-50k (trade 13 Oct), filed 9 Nov. source
  • House Democrat (NY-3): Buy US T-Bill $15k-50k (trade 15 Oct), filed 9 Nov. source
  • House Republican (TN-8): Sell WBD $1k-15k (trade 7 Oct), filed 9 Nov. source
  • Nothing filed 10 Nov in the feed yet. NY-3's mid-October T-bill buying aged well into the hot-CPI tape.

Trump / policy watch (24-48h)

  • Hot CPI + Waller's test met: December hike locked, 50bp live (~9.5%); Logan "more rapidly this winter"; Goolsbee: problem "all on the inflation side". BLS CPI
  • Oil below $90: Trump signals further Iran strikes "may not be necessary"; JPMorgan ~1.4mb/d October surplus. Trading Economics
  • NVDA probe widens: -5.47% day two; Culper on other China chip channels; Anthropic roadshow opened. MarketWatch
  • 10y at ~5%: 4.983% close, topped 5% intraday; 30y ~5.35% - duration gate 5.20% only ~22bp away. Trading Economics
  • VIX 19.46, -2.31%: fell even on a hot-CPI day - rotation, not panic. portfolio-terminal
  • Week ahead: Thu jobless claims + AMAT/CSCO + SMIC Q3; Fri PPI + Daly; BIS 50% Rule stay technically expired - Federal Register watch. FOMC calendar

Risk

  • Silver line ≈1.91x: collateral 1,777 oz × $51.92 × 1.2817 ≈ S$118,249 vs S$56,240 loan; equity ≈ S$62,009. Tuesday's -2.8% ≈ -5.3% of line equity - drifting back toward mid-October stress.
  • 50bp tail: duration gate ~22bp away; deployment could trigger INTO an accelerating hiking cycle.
  • NVDA probe contagion into SMIC Q3 (Thu) and NVDA earnings (17 Nov); Megaspeed Singapore nexus stays in the news.
  • Oil two-tail now downside-biased for the war premium - metals' premium deflating with it.
  • FX: ~35% of net worth non-SGD; USDSGD 1.2817. Concentration: STI rebound recovers only part of the month's -7.65% slide.

Alpha (signals, not advice)

  • TLT / Defense: prepare the first tranche toward the 15% target but deploy AT the 5.20% gate, not before - a 50bp hike likely punches through it. ~62% of the liquid book still idle cash.
  • SMIC 0981.HK: zone breakout (HK$47.24) a day before Q3 - if the GM 26-28% guide holds and price holds above ~46 post-print, begin a staged entry.
  • Silver: unchanged - ratio below ~1.7x AND spot above $55 before any add; the sub-$50 entry is getting closer, not further.

trumpWatch.title: Hot CPI meets Waller's 50bp test - December hike locked, jumbo live
trumpWatch.detail: October CPI +0.4% m/m vs +0.3% exp; core +0.3% vs +0.2% (third straight 0.3, no y/y published). Core exactly hit Waller's pre-set bar for considering 50bp ('credibility at risk'); Logan: 'more rapidly this winter'. CME FedWatch: ~90.5% 25bp, ~9.5% 50bp for the 8-9 Dec FOMC (FF 3.75-4.00%, chair Warsh).

trumpWatch.title: Brent below $90: Iran de-escalation plus a real supply surplus
trumpWatch.detail: Brent -2.58% to ~$90.18, first close below $90 since 31 Aug (-23% from the 30 Oct $118 high); WTI ~$84.74. Trump says further strikes 'may not be necessary'; JPMorgan pegs the October global surplus near 1.4mb/d as OPEC output rises. Waller caveat: Hormuz ship insurance and diesel refining keep energy costs sticky.

trumpWatch.title: NVDA probe fallout day two; chip-diversion story widens
trumpWatch.detail: NVDA -5.47% to $168.89 (two-day approx -9.5%) as the Jensen Huang board probe unwinds AI-complex premium; Culper Research says Megaspeed 'isn't the only company' helping China access chips. Anthropic opened its IPO roadshow (Nasdaq debut possible week of 16 Nov; S-1: $33.2bn 9M revenue, $895.4bn compute commitments, valuation above $1tn).

trumpWatch.title: 10y back at ~5%: closed 4.983%, topped 5% intraday
trumpWatch.detail: UST 10y +11.9bp to 4.983% (first 5% print in a week); 30y ~5.35% intraday, highest since 29 Oct. The 5.20% duration gate is only ~22bp away - a 50bp December tail would likely punch through it.

trumpWatch.title: VIX fell on a hot-CPI day: rotation, not panic
trumpWatch.detail: VIX 19.46, -2.31% even as CPI beat; SPX -0.38%, Dow -0.30%, Nasdaq -0.74%. Utilities down as yields rose - vol normalization continues while rate-sensitive corners absorb the hit.

trumpWatch.title: Rest of the week: SMIC Q3 Thursday, PPI Friday, BIS rule watch
trumpWatch.detail: Thu: jobless claims, AMAT and CSCO earnings, SMIC Q3 (guide GM 26-28%). Fri: PPI, Fed's Daly. The BIS '50% Rule' stay technically expired 9/10 Nov - watching the Federal Register for an extension notice (China/HK tech angle).

opportunities.thesis: Defense/long-duration sleeve: 10y at 4.983% is only ~22bp below the 5.20% gate, with core CPI exactly meeting Waller's 50bp test - a live jumbo-hike tail into the 8-9 Dec FOMC.
opportunities.signal: Prepare the first tranche toward the 15% Defense target now but deploy AT the gate (5.20%), not before - a 50bp hike likely punches through it and hands a better entry. ~62% of the liquid book still idle cash.

opportunities.thesis: Asia semis: SMIC broke above the HK$44-46 zone (HK$47.24, +2.6% on higher volume) one day before Q3 earnings on Thursday 12 Nov (guide: revenue +2-4% q/q, GM 26-28%).
opportunities.signal: Zone-hold condition met but the print is tomorrow: if Q3 holds the GM guide and price holds above ~46 post-print, begin a staged entry; NVDA probe fallout and Friday's US PPI are live headline risks on either side.

opportunities.thesis: Silver: IBKR line back to ~1.91x after Tuesday's -2.8% slide to $51.92 as the hot CPI deflated the metals war premium along with oil's (Brent below $90).
opportunities.signal: Unchanged: ratio below ~1.7x AND spot above $55 before any Real-assets add; with the war premium deflating and a 50bp tail in play, the sub-$50 entry is getting closer, not further.
